applicabilityBasis.summary: USDK is KAST Dollar, the non-yield payment-oriented branded USD token on M0 infrastructure. KAST-authored M0 research distinguishes USDK for payments from the separate USDKy yield product; this is apparent payment-token positioning, not a legal determination or authorization.

references.label: KAST-authored M0 research: USDK payments versus USDKy yield

genius.notes: KAST current terms identify KAST Tech (Reg No. 16223, Anjouan, Comoros), or relevant affiliates, as the platform company and state that it is not a bank. The existing issuerEntity string is retained under the load-bearing identity rule, but these general account terms do not independently identify the legal USDK mint/redemption obligor. Anjouan Offshore Finance Authority licensing was not evidenced by the opened primary terms and is omitted. The public terms describe a contractual KAST account debt claim and fiat withdrawals, not a USDK-specific token redemption policy; redemptionPolicyPresent is therefore false for a verified public token policy. M0 reserve disclosures concern upstream protocol collateral and validators, not a USDK-specific monthly CPA attestation. No named GENIUS approval, acknowledged token-issuer application, foreign registration/comparability decision, or formal KAST GENIUS undertaking was found in the consulted sources; an older unsourced founder aspiration is not adopted. Treasury still describes the expected January 18, 2027 effective date. This bounded review does not determine every filing or every token-holder legal right. The M0 dashboard was reopened but returned only a client shell; no current collateral balances were independently inspected. The reserve-disclosure link therefore points to the working primary M0 collateral/validator documentation and describes upstream collateral only.
